name: Follow Test Automation Best Practices
description: Apply the Test Pyramid principle: prefer fast unit tests, use integration tests for boundaries, and reserve E2E tests for critical paths. Keep tests independent, deterministic, and fast.

name: Write Clean and Maintainable Code
description: Write minimal, self-documenting code. Use meaningful names, avoid speculative abstractions, prefer editing existing files, and follow the language's idiomatic conventions.

name: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
description: Handle errors at system boundaries only. Use typed exceptions, log meaningful messages, avoid swallowing errors, and ensure failure modes are visible to the caller.

name: Create Detailed Documentation
description: Document the WHY (non-obvious constraints, invariants, workarounds), not the WHAT. Keep docs co-located with code and treat them as a first-class deliverable.

name: Perform Code Reviews
description: Review diffs for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. Raise actionable comments with suggested fixes rather than vague observations.

name: Optimise for Performance
description: Profile before optimising. Target the highest-impact bottlenecks — algorithmic complexity, I/O, database queries — and measure improvements with benchmarks.

name: Ensure Security Compliance
description: Validate all external input, sanitise outputs, manage secrets via environment variables or vaults, apply least-privilege access, and audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities.

name: Maintain Version Control Hygiene
description: Write atomic, descriptive commits. Use feature branches, rebase over merge where appropriate, tag releases, and never commit secrets or large binaries.

name: Implement Continuous Integration
description: Ensure every commit triggers automated build, lint, and test pipelines. Keep the main branch always deployable and fail fast on regressions.

name: Collaborate Effectively
description: Communicate intent before implementation. Ask clarifying questions early, surface blockers promptly, and provide concise progress summaries to stakeholders.
